question: Do BUS and BOKE observed pollen fractions move together across common 500-cal-BP bins, and can dated independent context support a land-use conclusion?
answer: Some source-local pollen changes may agree or contradict descriptively; dated SEAD site context lacks a qualified comparable ecological measurement, and LandClim grid 779 shares these input sites. No independent land-use or vegetation conclusion follows.

country_scope.SE: two named Swedish sites; descriptive within-country question only
country_scope.DK: not evaluated for this named two-site question
country_scope.NO: not evaluated for this named two-site question
country_scope.FI: not evaluated for this named two-site question

source_roles.neotoma: two independent observed-pollen site series, same exact taxon labels
source_roles.sead: independent dated site-location context only, not land-use magnitude
source_roles.landclim: model grid 779 with BUS/BOKE input-lineage overlap, excluded from validation outcome

bus_alternate_centre.source: Jenny et al. 2016 supplement Table S2; lake point, not BUS core
